messages.author: 97d82fedb7016adb
messages.subject: ADVI and na's
parts:
Hi!

I am struggling with ADVI as it aborts each time some na's pop-up somewhere, although I already try hard, the ODE integrator gives me occasionally na's. Is there a branch on stan-dev which has a fix for this and I could try?

... I even tried to get away with

if(is_nan(whatever)) { rescue me } else { do the usual thing }

but I guess this breaks gradients which screws ADVI.

Any ideas?

Sebastian

messages.subject: Re: ADVI and na's
parts:
hi sebastian, can you post the error you get specifically? curious at what point the na's are popping up. i recall this being an issue reported before and that was fixed in the auto-tuning branch. however, i don't recall where the error was in the first place so it's hard to spot where the auto-tuning branch may have fixed the bug. thanks!

Dustin

messages.author: 97d82fedb7016adb
messages.subject: Re: ADVI and na's
parts:
WHOW!!!

I just checked out the adapt-advi branch on cmdstan & stan (I think with the latest math) - and it works!

ADVI kept on going even though there were a few na "hickups" - it then found automatically a good eta (according to the messages) and at the very end I got my happy "CONVERGED" message.

Awesome!

Assuming that ADIV gives good results, which I am checking now, then this is fantastic news.

FYI: Full Bayes: ~1h vs ADVI: ~3 minutes

Cool!

Sebastian
